title: quarters
excerpt: never has a sliver of metal held so much weight.
body:
never has a sliver of metal held so
much weight.

each one, an arcade monument.
each ridge, a frame i run my finger along clicking through memories of

Spanish castles in Fanta bottles,
dead engines in Dennys water cups,
warm melodies in Outer Sunset townhouses,
monkey bars over Calpico jungles,
swan songs through stained clerestories,
wine goodbyes under tiny umbrellas,
cricket shuffles on camera lenses,
disco lights in dilated sunglasses.

like snow globes i shake
to remind me of all the places the months have taken me.

so thank you
to all who made this year unforgettable.
if i'm lucky. i'll live this long four times over.
